# agent-runtimes Documentation Index

> Universal runtime layer for local AI coding agents (opencode, claude,
> codex). One API: Runtime → Session → Run → RuntimeEvent. TypeScript,
> Node >= 20, Apache-2.0. Package: @stratosphereslab/agent-runtimes
> (published on npm).

## Getting Started

- Overview: docs/dev/getting-started/overview.md — what it is/isn't, the four-step flow.
- 101: docs/dev/getting-started/101.md — why CLIs differ and what gets normalized.
- Install: docs/dev/getting-started/install.md — build from source, verify with doctor.
- Quickstart: docs/dev/getting-started/quickstart.md — first run: detect → session → run → events.
- BFF: docs/dev/getting-started/bff.md — the thin slice above the library: SSE endpoint, drain/cancel/permission rules, runId grouping. Demos: examples/bff-sse.ts (raw SSE via EventSource) and examples/bff-assistant-ui.ts (the assistant-ui adapter's POST /turn contract; covered by tests/bff-assistant-ui.test.ts).
- assistant-ui: docs/dev/getting-started/assistant-ui.md — copy-paste React cookbook for the shipped adapter: provider, tool cards, Allow/Deny gate, reasoning, usage, data-* cards, error codes.
- Modes: docs/dev/getting-started/modes.md — "plan mode" means three things: permission vs agent axes, per-runtime field mapping, gaps.

## Architecture (docs/)

- docs/architecture.md — the model (Runtime≠Session≠Run≠Transport≠Parser), the 10 RuntimeEvent types, the seven hard rules.
- docs/development.md — setup, four gates (build/lint/typecheck/test), test tiers, adding a runtime, release.
- docs/frontend.md — wire contract for BFFs: event shapes, error-code taxonomy (switch on code, never message), drain-before-next-run rule, cancellation semantics.
- docs/frontend-assistant-ui.md — the shipped chat-UI adapter (@stratosphereslab/agent-runtimes/assistant-ui): RuntimeEvent → assistant-ui parts, SSE/NDJSON transport, approval gate, coverage and non-coverage.
- docs/runtime-authoring.md — new adapters: 5-file layout, input-surface channel map, checklist.
- docs/cross-platform.md — Windows/POSIX shims, signals, paths, stdin/stdout rules.

## Key API signatures

```ts
import { runtimes } from "@stratosphereslab/agent-runtimes";
const runtime = await runtimes.resolve("opencode" | "claude" | "codex");
const status = await runtime.detect(); // { installed: true, executable, version } | { installed: false }
const session = await runtime.createSession({ cwd?: string; model?: string });
const run = await session.run(prompt: string);
for await (const event of run.events()) { /* RuntimeEvent */ }
await run.cancel(); // ends stream with terminal `done`
await session.close();
const history = await session.history({ limit?: number; since?: number });
const installs = await runtime.installs(); // InstalledCopy[] { binary, shims, version, manager, invocable, selected }
```
